correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, nodes gb200-nvl4-ts2-99

low_level: Registers 36 to 255 over the 314 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (86 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 544 to 71680 bytes, harness 0.10 on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 512 to 768 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, no cell unsupported, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): latency not_guaranteed wins 20 of 89 cells (runner-up in 27), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 18 of 70 cells (runner-up in 16), throughput not_guaranteed wins 14 of 87 cells (runner-up in 24), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 17 of 70 cells (runner-up in 14).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 256, bf16 N 512, bf16 N 2048, bf16 N 4096, fp32 N 128, fp32 N 256, fp32 N 512, fp32 N 1024 and more), the median margin over the runner-up is +23 percent and over the scope's reference control +349 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 4096 k 16 +1647 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, fp32 N 4096 k 4 +1183 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +1073 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 16 +1064 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed.
Named workloads won on random input: eagle2_rerank_top60, sampling_merge_m8_k64.
negative: The GB200 pass measured random input only on one host (gb200-nvl4-ts2-99): the tie_heavy, shuffled-tie and phase 3b order-check findings for this adapter are on its B200 card.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
open_questions: B200 pass (WINNERS_b200.md, random input on umbriel-b200-047, tie_heavy on 068, shuffled ties on 094, phase 3b on 047): the warp and sub-warp winners agree with GB200 on 359 of 376 common cells (365 of 376 when each cell is compared through the adapters both passes measured, as section 16 of the knowledge base does), the differences are named sub-warp lane-count cells, N 128 sub-warp throughput cells and warp ties within 5 percent, and in the block matrices the B1_idx against B1_det2 throughput ties fall either way. On GB200 the k 64 cells at 128 threads run 3 to 15 percent slower than on B200 (hw-researcher, a generation property) and the aarch64 cicc emits branches for the conditional swaps (T20, 3 to 4 percent).
